News / PR Newswire / Charter Announces Pricing Terms of Tender Offers for Eight Series of Notes

Charter Announces Pricing Terms of Tender Offers for Eight Series of Notes 7 min read

CHTR STAMFORD, Conn., Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Charter Communications, Inc. ( CHTR , CHTRP) (along with its subsidiaries, "Charter") announced today the pricing terms of the previously announced eight separate offers (each, an "Offer" and, collectively, the "Offers") by its wholly-owned subsidiaries, Charter Communications Operating, LLC ("CCO") and Charter Communications Operating Capital Corp. ("CCO Capital" and, together with CCO, collectively, the "Issuers" or the "Company"), to purchase for cash the outstanding series of their notes listed in the table below (collectively, the "Notes" and each a "Series") for aggregate Consideration (as defined below) of up to $1.5 billion (the "Offer Cap"), excluding Accrued Interest and fees and expenses related to the Offers, on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Offer to Purchase dated November 10, 2026 (as supplemented, the "Offer to Purchase"). Capitalized terms used but not defined in this press release have the same meanings given to them in the Offer to Purchase. Certain information regarding the Notes and the pricing for the Offers is set forth in the table below. Acceptance Priority Level (1) Title of Security CUSIP/ISIN Number (2) Principal Amount Outstanding (3) Reference U.S. Treasury Security Reference Yield (4) Bloomberg Reference Page Fixed Spread (Basis Points) Consideration (5) 1 3.850% Senior Secured Notes Due 2061 161175BY9 / US161175BY99 $1,850 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2056 5.461 % FIT1 215 bps $543.71 2 3.950% Senior Secured Notes Due 2062 161175CG7 / US161175CG74 $1,400 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2056 5.461 % FIT1 220 bps $548.83 3 3.700% Senior Secured Notes Due 2051 161175BV5 / US161175BV50 $1,527 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2056 5.461 % FIT1 205 bps $576.70 4 3.900% Senior Secured Notes Due 2052 161175CA0 / US161175CA05 $1,884 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2056 5.461 % FIT1 205 bps $592.38 5 4.400% Senior Secured Notes Due 2061 161175CC6 / US161175CC60 $1,400 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2056 5.461 % FIT1 225 bps $600.90 6 3.500% Senior Secured Notes Due 2042 161175CE2 / US161175CE27 $897 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2046 5.506 % FIT1 205 bps $635.92 7 3.500% Senior Secured Notes Due 2041 161175BZ6 / US161175BZ64 $1,006 million 4.625% UST due August 15, 2036 5.101 % FIT1 250 bps $642.90 8 4.800% Senior Secured Notes Due 2050 161175BT0 / US161175BT05 $1,605 million 5.125% UST due August 15, 2056 5.461 % FIT1 220 bps $691.31

(1) Subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions of the Offers described in the Offer to Purchase, if the aggregate Consideration for all Notes validly tendered at or prior to the Expiration Date, and not validly withdrawn, exceeds the Offer Cap, the Company will accept Notes for purchase in the order of their respective Acceptance Priority Level specified in the table above (each, an "Acceptance Priority Level," with 1 being the highest Acceptance Priority Level and 8 being the lowest Acceptance Priority Level). It is possible that a Series of Notes with a particular Acceptance Priority Level will not be accepted for purchase or will be accepted only on a prorated basis.

(2) No representation is made as to the correctness or accuracy of the CUSIP numbers or ISINs listed above. Such information is provided solely for the convenience of the Holders of the Notes.

(3) Represents aggregate principal amount outstanding as of September 30, 2026.

(4) Each Reference Yield was determined by the Joint-Lead Dealer Managers based on the bid-side price of the applicable Reference U.S. Treasury Security at 3:00 p.m. (New York City time) on November 17, 2026 (the "Price Determination Date") quoted on the Bloomberg reference page "FIT1."

(5) The consideration for each $1,000 principal amount of each Series of Notes validly tendered, not validly withdrawn and accepted for purchase (the "Consideration") was determined in accordance with standard market practice, as described in the Offer to Purchase, to result in a price as of the Settlement Date based on a yield to the applicable par call date or maturity date (in accordance with market practice) in accordance with the formula set forth in Schedule A to the Offer to Purchase, for the applicable Series of Notes, equal to the sum of (i) the applicable Reference Yield plus (ii) the applicable Fixed Spread specified in the table above for such Series of Notes. The Consideration does not include the applicable Accrued Interest, which will be payable in cash in addition to the applicable Consideration.

The Offers will expire at 5:00 p.m. (New York City time) today, November 17, 2026 (such time and date, as it may be extended, the "Expiration Date"), unless extended or earlier terminated by the Company. Tendered Notes may be validly withdrawn at any time at or prior to the Withdrawal Deadline, which, unless the Offers are extended, is the Expiration Date, but not thereafter, unless otherwise required by applicable law. The "Settlement Date" will be the second business day after the Expiration Date and is expected to be November 19, 2026. The Offers remain subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions described in the Offer to Purchase, including the General Conditions. The complete terms and conditions of the Offers are set forth in the Offer to Purchase. Holders of Notes are urged to read the Offer to Purchase carefully. If proration of tendered Notes is required, the Company will use commercially reasonable efforts to announce the results of proration by press release prior to 10:00 a.m. (New York City time) on the business day following the Expiration Date. The Company intends to announce the results of the Offers in a separate press release following the Expiration Date. Information Relating to the Offers The Company has retained BofA Securities, Inc., J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC (the "Joint-Lead Dealer Managers") to act as joint-lead dealer managers for the Offers, and Barclays Capital Inc., Citigroup Global Markets Inc. and Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. (the "Co-Dealer Managers") to act as co-dealer managers for the Offers. Questions regarding terms and conditions of the Offers should be directed to BofA Securities, Inc., Liability Management Group at (888) 292-0070 (toll-free) or (980) 387-3907 (collect), J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, Liability Management Group at (866) 834-4666 (toll-free) or (212) 834-4087 (collect) or Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Liability Management Group at (800) 624-1808 (toll-free) or (212) 761-1057 (collect). D.F. King & Co., Inc. will act as the Information Agent and Tender Agent for the Offers. Questions or requests for assistance related to the Offers or for additional copies of the Offer to Purchase may be directed to D.F. King & Co., Inc. at (866) 416-0577 (toll-free) or (212) 993-7540 (banks and brokers) or by email at charter@dfking.com . Copies of the Offer to Purchase are also available at the following web address: www.dfking.com/charter . You may also contact your broker, dealer, commercial bank, trust company or other nominee for assistance concerning the Offers. If the Company terminates any Offer with respect to one or more Series of Notes, it will give prompt notice to the Information Agent and Tender Agent, and all Notes tendered pursuant to such terminated Offer will be returned promptly to the tendering Holders thereof. With effect from such termination, any Notes blocked in The Depository Trust Company ("DTC") will be released. Holders of Notes are advised to check with any bank, securities broker or other intermediary through which they hold Notes as to when such intermediary needs to receive instructions from a Holder in order for that Holder to be able to participate in, or (in the circumstances in which withdrawal is permitted) withdraw their instruction to participate in, the Offers before the deadlines specified herein and in the Offer to Purchase. The deadlines set by any such intermediary and DTC for the submission and withdrawal of tender instructions may be earlier than the relevant deadlines specified herein and in the Offer to Purchase . This press release is for informational purposes only. This press release is not an offer to purchase or a solicitation of an offer to purchase any Notes. The Offers are being made solely pursuant to the Offer to Purchase and related documents. The Offers are not being made to Holders of Notes in any jurisdiction in which the making or acceptance thereof would not be in compliance with the securities, blue sky or other laws of such jurisdiction. In any jurisdiction in which the securities laws or blue sky laws require the Offers to be made by a licensed broker or dealer, the Offers will be deemed to be made on behalf of the Company by the Joint-Lead Dealer Managers, the Co-Dealer Managers or one or more registered brokers or dealers that are licensed under the laws of such jurisdiction. None of the Company, the Joint-Lead Dealer Managers, the Co-Dealer Managers, the Tender Agent, the Information Agent, and the Trustee with respect to any Notes is making any recommendation as to whether Holders of Notes should tender any Notes in response to the Offers, and neither the Company nor any such other person has authorized any person to make any such recommendation. Holders of Notes must make their own decision as to whether to tender any of their Notes, and, if so, the principal amount of Notes to tender. About Charter Charter Communications, Inc. ( CHTR , CHTRP), through its Spectrum brand, is the leading internet and video provider in the nation and the fastest growing mobile company in our footprint, with services available to more than 70 million homes and businesses across 45 states. Supported by our 100% U.S.-based employees,* we are America's Internet Company®. More information about Charter can be found at corporate.charter.com. *At close of the Cox acquisition, Spectrum announced that over the next 18 months, it will fully return legacy Cox's customer service function to the U.S.

item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Sandisk's Earnings Face a New Risk in a Key Chip Market

Sandisk's Earnings Face a New Risk in a Key Chip Market 1 min read

SNDK MU GF Securities cut its 2027 price forecast for NAND flash aaazxswq2memory, saying faster supply growth and weaker demand could leave the market oversupplied next year. The firm sees Sandisk SNDK as more exposed to falling NAND prices than Micron Technology MU or SK hynix because its business is concentrated in flash storage. GF expects NAND prices to be flat in the first quarter of 2027 and fall in each of the next three quarters, Seeking Alpha reported. The firm pointed to softer demand for consumer electronics and weaker purchasing in China as production growth accelerates. NAND is the memory that stores data in devices such as smartphones and solid-state drives. There are already signs of pressure in the spot market. TrendForce reported Tuesday that NAND spot prices fell about 20% in two weeks as Chinese traders reduced inventories. The drop shows what buyers are paying for immediate purchases. The next question is whether it carries over to the contract prices that suppliers negotiate with large customers. GF expects Sandisk's earnings to be the most volatile of the three. The firm sees a stronger outlook for DRAM, the working memory used in computers and servers, and favors Micron, SK hynix and Samsung Electronics because they also sell DRAM and high-bandwidth memory used in AI systems. Investors Takeaway For Sandisk, the next test is whether lower contract prices start to squeeze margins, especially if customers cut orders at the same time. For Micron and SK hynix, the question is how much stronger pricing for DRAM and high-bandwidth memory can offset weaker flash sales. The split matters because falling prices in one type of memory can hit suppliers' earnings very differently.
